name: SNEEZE archive media selector

original_modules.role: Archive thumbnail/zoom gallery and optional Vimeo modal

original_runtime_dependencies.optional_video_modal: Bundled Vimeo player module1 and Bootstrap modal plugin; not required by the standalone background-video selector.

original_module_reference_limits: original-modules.js preserves exact Browserify entries and require mappings; it is a source reference, not an independently bootable bundle. Original page module64 also refers to section base61 and nonarchive caption variants70/71; complete theme URL is recorded. Use archive-selector.js for the standalone selection behavior.

data_contract.thumbnail_order: Sibling index in [data-thumb] parent corresponds to [data-zoom] img order.

behavior: Ticker click activates the caption/background with the same ID and hides previous selection.
Hover/touchstart preloads thumbs; it does not change the background.
Selected native video is muted/looping/inline, lazily loads sources and plays oncanplay; hiding pauses it.
Caption selection loads thumbs and large gallery images; background-only items are valid.
Thumb opens a fixed viewport image overlay using contain fit; clicking it fades images out and hides overlay after200ms.
Original ticker shifts up only when a caption is active; header logo resets selection.

source_timings.marquee_speed: data-speed5.3 pixels per animation frame, not per second.

source_vs_upload: Feature sections are semantically identical; exact markup differs only by two nonbreaking spaces in the older2020 Reebok description. Requested2022 Reebok item is unchanged.

dependency_validation.font_files: No webfont URLs; system font stack.
